title: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker…
description: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands. This is due to improper neutralization of user-supplied input before it is passed to the operating system, leading to command injection.
